info.title: Mirabello Consultancy — Investment Migration API
info.description: Read-only REST mirror of the Mirabello MCP server: CBI/RBI programmes, cost estimates, and passport mobility. Indicative data; not legal/financial advice. © Mirabello Consultancy Ltd.

get.summary: Estimate total cost for a family.
Ranked shortlist for a client profile.

Compare programmes. Pass a + b (two programme ids) for the canonical versioned comparison artefact from the Mirabello Investment Migration Index (rank, composite, dimension scores, per-dimension deltas, per-metric leads a|b|tie, human compare page URL where one exists). Or pass ids (comma-separated, 2-4) for the classic side-by-side comparison. Comparative facts only, no recommendation.

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: programme id (use with b) for the canonical two-programme artefact

400.description: Unknown or identical programme ids; the response includes valid_ids_reference (/v1/index)

get.summary: The Mirabello Freedom Compass — ORIGIN-AWARE path planner. Given the person's current citizenship(s) + goal, returns ranked end-to-end routes with the mobility delta over their existing passport, eligibility, multi-leg steps, and a CITATION-FIRST provenance block per route (verified_date, confidence, official source_url, source_tier) plus a top-level verification summary. Informational only.

parameters.name: from_citizenship
parameters.description: ISO alpha-2 code(s), comma-separated, e.g. IN or US,GB

parameters.name: budget_usd
parameters.description: Approximate investment budget in USD — treated as a ±15% band (routes within ~15% above or below are the cost sweet-spot; cheaper still shown, far-over penalised).

200.description: Ranked origin-aware routes, each with a provenance block (verified_date, confidence, source_url, source_tier, status), plus a verification summary. Call /provenance for full W3C-PROV citations.

get.summary: The Mirabello Investment Migration Index — composite ranking of CBI/RBI programmes with transparent methodology.

CBI passport-renewal artefact for a programme country (St Kitts & Nevis, Antigua & Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, St Lucia, Vanuatu): official government renewal fees (currency-primary EC$/GBP/VT + USD approx, adult/child/lost-stolen), passport validity (adult/child years), typical processing, remote-renewal capability (Vanuatu is in-person biometric), biometric status, ECCIRA status (postponed to mid-2026, existing rules in force), biometric/ECCIRA deadlines, official source URLs, last_verified and the Mirabello /passport-renewal page. Omit country for all six (the overview artefact). Information only, not advice.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: programme id (e.g. st-kitts-cbi, st-lucia-cbi) or country alias; omit for all six

200.description: Renewal artefact for one country, or the six-country overview when country is omitted

400.description: Unknown country id; the response includes valid_ids (the six programme ids)

post.summary: Book a free consultation (requires email + explicit GDPR consent).
Generate a personalised programme briefing: profile in, ranked shortlist with family cost math + shareable 90-day briefing URL out. Optional email+consent registers specialist follow-up.
